notes: ADMX haloscope search for QCD axion dark matter over 3.3-4.2 ueV. Paper reports 90% CL upper limits on g_agamma vs mass (Fig. 4) excluding KSVZ over 3.3-4.2 ueV and DFSZ over 3.9-4.1 ueV. No numeric table of limit values provided; the two emitted points are the KSVZ-model g_agamma at the mass-range endpoints (m_a=5.7 ueV*(1e12/f_a), g=alpha*g_gamma/(pi*f_a), g_gamma=-0.97), which represents the achieved exclusion level. Actual measured limit curve is somewhat below (DFSZ) in part of range and above (2x DFSZ) elsewhere; values approximate.
